chunks: And ʿAlī ibn Jaʿfar asked his brother Mūsā ibn Jaʿfar عليهما السلام:
About a woman leading women in salat (prayer): what is the limit of raising her voice in the takbīr and the recitation? So he said: “To the extent that she makes them hear.”

key_terms.الْمَرْأَةِ: the woman serving as the prayer leader

ai.seo_question: How loud should a woman recite when leading other women in congregational salat (prayer)?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling regarding a woman who leads other women in congregational salat (prayer). Her voice in takbīr and recitation should be raised only to the extent necessary for those praying behind her to hear.
